name: Union Insurance Co., Ltd.
summary: Operating across Taiwan and Thailand, Union Insurance Co., Ltd. delivers a comprehensive portfolio of insurance solutions. Its offerings encompass a wide range of coverage: Fire Insurance: Extensive options for both residential and commercial properties, including protection against fire, earthquake, typhoon, and flood damages. Transportation Insurance: Policies covering cargo, hull, fishing vessels, and aviation, alongside liability protection for cargo carriers and maritime contractors. Motor Insurance: Automotive plans featuring voluntary coverage for vehicle body damage and third-party liability, as well as compulsory liability insurance for cars and motorcycles. Engineering Insurance: Provisions addressing risks associated with construction (comprehensive and installation), machinery (including boilers), and electronic equipment. Liability Insurance: Solutions spanning general and professional liability, guarantee bonds, and comprehensive packages for individuals and businesses, alongside various other property-related coverages. Accident Insurance: Protection ranging from personal and group accident plans to travel safety and micro-insurance options. Health Insurance: Medical coverage tailored for both groups and individuals. The company also provides a selection of reinsurance products. Established in 1963, Union Insurance Co., Ltd. maintains its headquarters in Taiwan's capital, Taipei City.
